dialogues.title: At the doctor's
dialogues.context: Birkaç gündür boğazın ağrıyor ve ateşin var. Doktora gittin.

lines.en: Come in, have a seat. What seems to be the problem?
alternatives: Have a seat. What's bothering you?

lines.en: I'm not feeling well. I have a sore throat.
alternatives: I've had a sore throat and I feel awful.

lines.en: How long have you had this?
alternatives: When did it start?

lines.en: I've had it for three days, and it's getting worse.
lines.tr: Üç gündür var ve gittikçe kötüleşiyor.
alternatives: About three days now — worse each day.

lines.en: Any fever? Headaches?
alternatives: Have you had a temperature?

lines.en: A bit of a fever, and I feel dizzy when I stand up.
lines.tr: Biraz ateşim var, ayağa kalkınca başım dönüyor.
alternatives: Some fever, and I get dizzy standing up.

lines.en: Let me have a look. Open wide, please.
alternatives: Let's take a look — say 'ah'.

lines.en: It's a throat infection. I'll write you a prescription.
alternatives: You've got an infection — I'll prescribe something.

lines.en: I'm allergic to penicillin.
alternatives: Just so you know — penicillin is a problem for me.

lines.en: Good that you mentioned it. I'll use something else.
lines.tr: Söylemeniz iyi oldu. Başka bir şey vereceğim.
alternatives: Thanks for telling me — I'll prescribe an alternative.

lines.en: How often should I take it?
alternatives: How many times a day?

lines.en: Twice a day, after meals, for one week.
lines.tr: Günde iki kez, yemeklerden sonra, bir hafta boyunca.
alternatives: Two a day with food, for seven days.

lines.en: Are there any side effects?
alternatives: Anything I should watch out for?

lines.en: It may make you drowsy. Take it easy for a few days.
lines.tr: Uykunuzu getirebilir. Birkaç gün kendinizi yormayın.
alternatives: You might feel sleepy — rest up this week.

dialogues.title: At the pharmacy
dialogues.context: Öksürüyorsun ve reçeten yok. Eczaneden bir şey almak istiyorsun.

lines.en: Hi, how can I help you today?
alternatives: Hello — what can I get you?

lines.en: Do you have anything for a cough?
lines.tr: Öksürük için bir şeyiniz var mı?
alternatives: I need something for a cough.

lines.en: Is it dry or with mucus?
alternatives: Dry cough, or a chesty one?

lines.en: Dry, mostly at night.
alternatives: It's dry — it keeps me up at night.

lines.en: This syrup works well for that.
lines.tr: Bu şurup onun için iyi gelir.
alternatives: I'd recommend this syrup.

lines.en: Do I need a prescription for this?
alternatives: Is that over-the-counter?

lines.en: No, it's over-the-counter.
alternatives: No prescription needed.

lines.en: How often should I take it?
alternatives: What's the dose?

lines.en: Two spoonfuls before bed. Don't drive after.
lines.tr: Yatmadan önce iki kaşık. Sonrasında araba kullanmayın.
alternatives: Two spoons at night — it'll make you sleepy.

lines.en: Good to know. One more thing — I ran out of my medication.
lines.tr: İyi ki söylediniz. Bir şey daha, ilacım bitti.
alternatives: Understood. Also, I need a refill on this.

lines.en: I can refill that if you have the old box.
alternatives: Have you got the packet? I can sort that.

lines.en: Here it is. Thanks, you're a lifesaver.
alternatives: Right here — thank you so much.

dialogues.title: Calling for help
dialogues.context: Sokakta biri düştü ve kalkamıyor. Acil servisi arıyorsun. Sakin kalıp net bilgi vermelisin.

lines.en: Emergency services. Which service do you need?
alternatives: Emergency — police, fire, or ambulance?

lines.en: An ambulance, please. Someone's been hurt.
alternatives: Ambulance — there's been an accident.

lines.en: Stay calm. What's your location?
alternatives: Okay, where are you exactly?

lines.en: On King Street, across from the bank.
alternatives: King Street — right opposite the bank.

lines.en: Is the person conscious?
alternatives: Is he awake and responding?

lines.en: He's awake but he can't get up. His leg looks bad.
lines.tr: Uyanık ama kalkamıyor. Bacağı kötü görünüyor.
alternatives: He's conscious, but he can't stand — his leg is injured.

lines.en: Is he breathing normally?
alternatives: Any trouble breathing?

lines.en: Yes, he's breathing fine.
alternatives: Breathing's okay, yes.

lines.en: Don't move him. An ambulance is on its way.
alternatives: Leave him where he is — help is coming.

lines.en: How long will it be?
alternatives: Any idea how long?

lines.en: About six minutes. Can you stay with him?
lines.tr: Altı dakika kadar. Yanında kalabilir misiniz?
alternatives: Six minutes or so — please stay with him.

lines.en: Yes, I'm here if you need anything else.
lines.tr: Evet, başka bir şey gerekirse buradayım.
alternatives: Of course, I'll wait with him.
